attributes.action: Close schools if it is over 28 degrees
attributes.additional_details: Schools need to close when over 28 degrees due to children struggling to concentrate and the safety of the children
attributes.background: If the weather is over 28 degrees all schools should shut due to the safety of children because when it is that hot children are getting heat stroke and cant concentrate which means there is no point in the schools being open because the children cant learn

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
